question: Should memory-wiki isolation be solved through a generic agents.list[].plugins config override contract, a memory-wiki-specific per-agent vault contract, or context-aware vault.path templating/layering?
rationale: The request changes config/API surface and security boundaries for durable agent memory, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product and upgrade contract from source evidence alone.

options.title: Design generic agent-scoped plugin config
options.body: Add a shared per-agent plugin config contract with precedence, SecretRef/redaction, validation, lifecycle, doctor, docs, and memory-wiki coverage.

options.title: Keep plugin config global and scope memory-wiki
options.body: Add memory-wiki-owned per-agent vault routing or layered vault config without creating a general plugin override surface.

options.title: Use templated vault paths only
options.body: Allow context-aware vault.path expansion where runtime context exists, while defining fail-closed behavior for CLI/gateway/no-agent contexts.

recommendation.title: Design generic agent-scoped plugin config
recommendation.body: Add a shared per-agent plugin config contract with precedence, SecretRef/redaction, validation, lifecycle, doctor, docs, and memory-wiki coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans plugin config runtime, strict config schema, security-sensitive extension contracts, and current related config-boundary work where steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal.
